Welcome to The Whimsy Corner!



Hello! Welcome to my little space on the internet were I share my art and other special interests I am interested in! I've gotten tired of the social media I've been using. Most of them are allowing AI to run rampant. I then thought I should make a space for myself were I can post my art. And then I learned that the indie web was a thing. I realized I can use this website to post my art and share my other special interests. This was a good reason to finally learn web development .

I love to bring a chill, and cosy vibe, fun, acceptance, and open-mindedness the space I am in. If you like the energy, stick around! But please be mindful of the energy you bring into this space!

I'm still learning so if something looks off or is broken I apologize. Feel free to offer any tips on how I could make the site better! I was thinking of ways to make the site more accesisble. I'm not sure if the fonts I used are readable. If you have a hard time reading them let me know!

Also I do have gifs visible on the page. I know that will be an issue for some disabled viwers so I added buttons to turn off the gifs. There will be some pages where the buttons doesn't work like the blog and gallery pages so be careful on those pages!
